title: Understanding Non-Gaussian Chorus Wave Statistics via the Benjamin-Feir Index
summary: We derive an extended wave action model for equatorial chorus waves, identifying a wave activity index (a version of the Benjamin-Feir index, BFI) which indicates non-Gaussian frequency spectra emerge when BFI$>$0.5. Global maps of this index indicate the night and dawn sectors ($0<{\rm MLT}<9)$ of the magnetosphere as the primary region for non-Gaussian wave statistics to emerge. Comparisons with events measured by the Van Allen probe A demonstrate good qualitative agreement whilst identifying key aspects for model refinement.
